result.title: SWE-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Coding
result.summary: In this work, we study on-policy distillation (OPD) for transferring agentic coding capabilities from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. Prior work has focused primarily on reasoning and short-horizon agentic tasks. We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. Across three teacher--student pairs, two training sources, and three SWE benchmarks, we find that on-policy supervision transfers coding capability: supervision from Qwen3.6-27B increases the SWE-bench Pro resolve rate of Qwen3.5-9B from 35.9% to 39.4%. Refreshing trajectories is not strictly required either, as an offline variant with cached teacher scores still improves over the student baselines while cutting end-to-end GPU-hours by 59.4%--72.6% and halving peak GPU allocation, at benchmark-dependent accuracy. Furthermore, we extend the offline variant to corss-tokenizer scenarios: distilling GLM-4.5-Air from DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 raises its SWE-bench Pro and Multilingual resolve rate from 35.8% to 39.7% and from 41.8% to 46.2%, around 4% and 4.6% improvement, respectively. We also find that a decreasing loss, however, does not necessarily indicate improved agent performance: under top-$K$ reverse-KL loss, one student exhibits severe repetition despite a decreasing loss. We identify a support-mass gradient term as a potential mechanism underlying this failure.

AI.brief_summary: 研究面向软件工程智能体的 on-policy 蒸馏（SWE-OPD）：学生模型与可执行仓库交互，教师在学生访问到的前缀上进行监督，跨三组师生模型、两种训练来源与三个 SWE 基准验证能力迁移，并给出用缓存教师分数的离线变体与跨 tokenizer 扩展；同时报告损失下降与智能体表现脱节的现象。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本智能体编码任务，但其「在学生实际访问前缀上做教师分布监督」及缓存离线监督，可能为 LVR 中潜在推理轨迹的逐步监督与贡献分配提供借鉴；损失下降却性能退化及 support-mass 梯度项的诊断也值得核查是否对应潜状态信息坍缩。
